title: Western, Religious or Spiritual: An Evaluation of Moral Justification in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper directly evaluates Large Language Models based on three moral perspective categories: Western tradition, Abrahamic tradition (religious), and Spiritualist/Mystic tradition. It examines which values and principles are embedded in LLMs during moral justification and explores potential 'over-alignment' towards religious values, making it centrally focused on faith, ethics, and morals.
